working: [Fe(ox)3]3- is a tris(bidentate) octahedral complex of type [M(AA)3]. It has D3 symmetry with no mirror plane, so it exists as Δ and Λ enantiomers and is chiral. Statement I is correct. In trans-[Cr(H2O)2(ox)2]-, the two oxalate ligands lie in one plane and the two water ligands are trans to each other. That equatorial plane is a mirror plane, so the complex is achiral. Statement II is incorrect.
